new:
Adapters may own executable discovery, provider authentication, launch
arguments, environment placement, and provider diagnostics. They do not own
authoring semantics, GameEngine permission policy, work-claim policy,
completion gates, or canonical project persistence.

AI Studio must not execute adapter discovery, provider process startup, Managed
Local endpoint startup, or ACP initialize/session negotiation on the egui frame
thread. It prepares the immutable Agent Host binding first, starts runtime/session
opening on a background worker, and only polls progress/completion from the UI.
The worker-opened session is attached only after the bridge re-validates the
original GameEngine session/run binding and, for a run, confirms that the run is
still non-terminal. Cancellation drops the pending startup authority; a late
worker result is cancelled/closed rather than attached to a newer interaction.
The synchronous `AcpAgentRuntime::open_session` contract may remain inside the
provider-neutral runtime boundary, but presentation code must not call that
blocking contract directly.

### 10. Managed Local Agent Harness benchmarks normally use Goose ACP
